scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.setup:local: npm run install:all && npm run db:up && npm run db:wait && npm run migrate && npm run seed && npm run db:smoke
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
scripts.test:regression: npm run test:regression --prefix backend && npm run test:regression --prefix frontend
